data.name: This name will be prefixed to all parameter values (change as you like)
data.inverter_serial: Device Serial Number (retrieve from the web interface)
data.lookup_file: The yaml file to use for parameter-definition
data.ac_max_power: AC output capacity in W (0 = use the inverter's Rated Power)
data.pv_monitored_inputs: PV inputs with a panel connected
data.pv_problem_threshold: Problem below this % of the other modules' median output
data.pv_problem_minutes: Minutes below the threshold before raising the problem
data.pv_min_power: Minimum reference power in W to evaluate
data.pv_min_sun_elevation: Minimum sun elevation in degrees to evaluate

data_description.use_sun_for_polling: When enabled, the integration checks Home Assistant's sun position (based on your home's location) and skips querying the inverter while the sun is below the threshold below, instead of retrying and logging warnings all night.
data_description.sun_elevation_threshold: Minimum sun elevation, in degrees above the horizon, required before polling resumes. Use a small negative value (e.g. -4) to allow for dawn/dusk twilight.
data_description.ac_max_power: Used for the "AC Output Load" sensor (power ÷ capacity). Leave 0 to use the Rated Power register.
data_description.pv_monitor: Raises the "PV Problem" binary sensor when a module produces much less than the other modules of the same inverter. Needs at least 3 monitored inputs.
data_description.pv_monitored_inputs: Untick inputs without a panel, otherwise they would be reported as a problem.
data_description.pv_problem_threshold: Each module is compared with the median of the others, so clouds (which affect all alike) do not trigger it.
data_description.pv_problem_minutes: Only valid samples count (inverter connected, sun high enough, enough reference power).
data_description.pv_min_power: Below this the comparison is skipped (overcast, dawn, dusk).
data_description.pv_min_sun_elevation: Below this elevation the comparison is skipped.
